note: Complete public scientific-checker bank. Inactive unless SCIBENCH_TRIGGER_LOG is set.

checkers.alarm: `|F(a,b)-F(b,a)| > tol`, or `F` outside `[-tol, 1+tol]`, or `|F(UaU†,UbU†)-F| > tol` (`tol = C*eps_d*d^2` when either state is a `Statevector`, `C*sqrt(eps_d)*d` when both are `DensityMatrix` (sqrt route); probe `U` is a permutation matrix, an exact transform, X). Pre also requires `|tr-1| <= 1e-9` and `lambda_min >= -eps_d*d`
checkers.invariant: `F(a,b) = F(b,a)`, `0 <= F <= 1`, and `F(UaU†, UbU†) = F(a,b)` for a unitary `U`
checkers.precondition: valid `Statevector`/`DensityMatrix` pairs of equal dimension, any mix of pure/mixed
checkers.rationale: the pure/mixed branches use different formulas; fidelity underlies every benchmarking result.

checkers.alarm: `|F(a,a)-1| > tol` or `F(Tr_B a, Tr_B b) < F(a,b) - tol` (`tol = C*eps_d*d^2`)
checkers.invariant: `F(a,a) = 1` and `F(Tr_B a, Tr_B b) >= F(a,b)` (data processing)
checkers.precondition: valid states `a, b` of a bipartite system
checkers.rationale: normalisation of the mixed-state formula and a physical monotonicity property of any valid fidelity.

checkers.alarm: `S < -tol` or `S > log_base d + tol`, or `|S(PρP^T) - S(ρ)| > tol` for a permutation `P`, or `S > tol` when `purity >= 1 - eps_d*d`. `tol = C*eps_d*d^2*40/ln(base)` (eigenvalue error `eps_d*d` enters as `p log(1/p)`); the purity gate uses the same tol; Pre also requires `|tr-1| <= 1e-9` and `lambda_min >= -eps_d*d`
checkers.invariant: `0 <= S <= log_base d`; `S(UρU†) = S(ρ)`; `S = 0` iff pure
checkers.rationale: entropy is the entanglement/mixedness currency.

checkers.alarm: any inequality violated by more than `tol = C*eps_d*d*log d`
checkers.invariant: `0 <= I(A:B) <= 2 min(log dA, log dB)` and `|S_A - S_B| <= S_AB <= S_A + S_B` (Araki-Lieb, subadditivity)
checkers.rationale: violated inequalities signal a wrong reduced state or entropy.

checkers.alarm: the two the result differs from `2 s_0 s_1` (`s_i` the Schmidt coefficients of the pure state) by more than `tol = 64*sqrt(eps_d)` (both routes take a square root of an eigenvalue that may be rounding-level small), or `C` outside `[-tol, 1+tol]`
checkers.invariant: `C(Statevector ψ) = C(DensityMatrix |ψ><ψ|)`, and `0 <= C <= 1`
checkers.rationale: two independent definitions of one entanglement measure.

checkers.alarm: `E_F` differs from the Shannon entropy of the squared Schmidt coefficients, or lies outside `[-tol, 1+tol]`, with `tol = 64*sqrt(eps_d)`
checkers.invariant: `E_F(Statevector) = E_F(DensityMatrix)`, `0 <= E_F <= 1`, and `E_F = h((1+sqrt(1-C^2))/2)` for that state's `C`
checkers.rationale: Wootters formula vs reduced-state entropy must agree on pure states.

checkers.alarm: `|N - N_schmidt| > C*eps_d*d^2` or `N < -tol`
checkers.invariant: `N = ((sum_i lambda_i)^2 - 1)/2` with `lambda_i` the Schmidt coefficients (singular values of the raw amplitude matrix reshaped as `qargs` vs the rest, little-endian), and `N >= 0`
checkers.precondition: valid pure bipartite `Statevector`, partial transpose over one subsystem
checkers.rationale: independent path to the same entanglement monotone.

checkers.alarm: outside bounds by more than `C*eps_d*d`, or complement purities differ
checkers.invariant: `1/d <= Tr ρ^2 <= 1`, and purity is invariant under partial-trace-complement for pure bipartite states: `purity(ρ_A) = purity(ρ_B)`
checkers.observation_point: return of `purity` (bipartite case: also reduced states)
checkers.rationale: Schmidt symmetry of pure states.

checkers.alarm: independent recomputation through the other route differs by more than `C*eps_d*d^3`
checkers.invariant: Choi-state fidelity `F(ρ_E, ρ_U)` equals `Tr[S_U† S_E]/d^2`
checkers.precondition: a CPTP channel `E` (from Kraus operators) and a unitary `U` of equal dimension
checkers.rationale: docstring states both as equal definitions.

checkers.alarm: outside bounds by more than `C*eps_d*d^3`
checkers.invariant: `F_ave = (d F_pro + 1)/(d+1)` and `1/(d+1) <= F_ave <= 1`; `gate_error = 1 - F_ave in [0, d/(d+1)]`
checkers.rationale: a CPTP channel cannot be worse than the minimum of the twirled fidelity.

checkers.alarm: `|F_pro(U,U)-1| > tol` or conjugation changes `F_pro`
checkers.invariant: `F_pro(U, U) = 1`, and `F_pro(U, V) = F_pro(WUW†, WVW†)` for unitary `W`
checkers.rationale: process fidelity is basis independent.

checkers.alarm: min eigenvalue `< -C*eps_d*d^2*||Choi||` or `||Tr_out Choi - I|| > C*eps_d*d^2`
checkers.invariant: the `Choi` result has non-negative eigenvalues and `Tr_out(Choi) = I`
checkers.rationale: representation changes must not break CPTP.
checkers.scientific_quantity: Choi matrix of a CPTP map

checkers.alarm: action on a fixed test state differs from the source representation's by more than `C*eps_d*d^3*||E||`
checkers.invariant: `E(ρ)` is identical in every representation
checkers.precondition: CPTP channel in any of `Kraus, Choi, SuperOp, PTM, Chi, Stinespring`; random test state `ρ`
checkers.rationale: all representations describe one linear map.

checkers.alarm: difference on a test state `> C*eps_d*d^3`
checkers.invariant: `(E.compose(F))(ρ) = E(F(ρ))`, and `E.tensor(F)` acts as product map on product states
checkers.precondition: two CPTP channels `E, F` of equal dimension
checkers.rationale: composition order and qubit ordering are conventions easily inverted.

checkers.alarm: Hermiticity, trace, or min eigenvalue off by more than `C*eps_d*d^2`
checkers.invariant: `E(ρ)` is Hermitian, PSD, trace one
checkers.rationale: physical output.

checkers.alarm: norm deviates by more than `C*eps_d*d`
checkers.rationale: probability conservation.

checkers.alarm: amplitude difference `> C*eps_d*d*depth`
checkers.invariant: `Statevector(|0>).evolve(qc)` equals `Operator(qc) |0>`; and `DensityMatrix.evolve(qc)` equals `U ρ U†`
checkers.rationale: two independent simulation paths.

checkers.alarm: marginal mismatch or sum off by more than `C*eps_d*d`
checkers.invariant: `probabilities(qargs)` equals the marginal of `probabilities()`; and sums to 1; for a DensityMatrix equals the diagonal of the reduced state
checkers.rationale: qubit-ordering conventions across subsets.

checkers.alarm: validity or expectation mismatch `> C*eps_d*d^2`
checkers.invariant: `partial_trace` result is a valid state, and `Tr[(O⊗I) ρ] = Tr[O ρ_reduced]` for a test Hermitian `O`
checkers.rationale: definition of the reduced state.

checkers.alarm: imaginary part `> C*eps_d*d*||H||`, outside the spectral interval, or routes differ
checkers.invariant: `<H>` has zero imaginary part and lies in `[λmin, λmax]`; the Operator and SparsePauliOp paths agree for a Pauli-expressed `H`
checkers.rationale: observable measurement must be real.

checkers.alarm: matrix difference `> C*eps_d*d^3`
checkers.invariant: `A.compose(B).data = B@A`, `A.dot(B).data = A@B`, `A.tensor(B) = kron(A,B)`, `A.expand(B) = kron(B,A)`
checkers.rationale: qubit-order conventions underlie every circuit-to-matrix conversion.

checkers.alarm: unitarity defect `> C*eps_d*d*depth`, or inverse mismatch
checkers.invariant: `Operator(qc)` satisfies `U†U = I`; and `Operator(qc.inverse()) = Operator(qc)†`
checkers.precondition: circuit of `<= 8` qubits of unitary gates
checkers.rationale: every gate must be a unitary.

checkers.alarm: symplectic condition fails
checkers.invariant: the `2n x 2n` binary symplectic block `S` satisfies `S Ω S^T = Ω (mod 2)`
checkers.precondition: any `Clifford` constructed or composed through the API
checkers.rationale: invalid tableau is no Clifford.

checkers.alarm: operators differ (up to phase) by more than `C*eps_d*d^2`
checkers.invariant: `Clifford(qc).to_operator()` equals `Operator(qc)` up to global phase, and `P -> C P C†` computed by `Pauli.evolve(Clifford)` equals the matrix conjugation
checkers.rationale: stabilizer vs state-vector simulation must agree.

checkers.alarm: mismatch
checkers.invariant: `P.commutes(Q)` iff `PQ = QP` as matrices; `(P.compose(Q)).to_matrix() = Q@P` exactly
checkers.rationale: sign tracking underlies VQE.

checkers.alarm: matrix difference exceeds that bound
checkers.invariant: `simplify`, `compose`, `tensor`, `adjoint`, `sum` give the same matrix as the corresponding dense algebra (`simplify` within `C*eps_d*terms*max|coeff|`)
checkers.rationale: Hamiltonians are manipulated only in this representation.

checkers.alarm: defect `> C*eps_d*d^2`
checkers.invariant: `random_unitary` unitary; `random_density_matrix` Hermitian PSD trace 1; `random_statevector` unit norm; `random_clifford` symplectic; `random_quantum_channel` CPTP; `random_hermitian` Hermitian; `random_pauli` valid
checkers.rationale: benchmarks sample from these.

checkers.alarm: phase-aligned difference `> C*eps_d`
checkers.invariant: the synthesised circuit's operator equals the input up to global phase (and exactly if the phase is returned)
checkers.precondition: any `2x2` unitary, any supported basis (U3, U321, U, PSX, ZSX, ZSXX, ZYZ, ZXZ, XYX, XZX, RR)
checkers.rationale: synthesis is the core of compilation.

checkers.alarm: reassembly error `> tol` or coordinates outside the chamber
checkers.invariant: `TwoQubitWeylDecomposition` reassembles to `U` (including global phase) and `(a,b,c)` satisfy `pi/4 >= a >= b >= |c|`
checkers.rationale: gates are classified by these coordinates.

checkers.alarm: operator mismatch `> tol` or `> 3` CX
checkers.invariant: synthesised circuit equals `U` up to global phase; number of CX `<= 3`; local-equivalence invariants (Makhlin) match
checkers.rationale: optimality and correctness.

checkers.alarm: operator/tableau difference `> tol`
checkers.invariant: `qs_decomposition` circuit equals `U` up to phase; `synth_clifford_*` circuit reproduces the tableau
checkers.precondition: unitary on `<=4` qubits; Clifford on `<=6` qubits
checkers.rationale: end-to-end semantic preservation.

checkers.alarm: matrix difference `> C*eps_d*d`
checkers.invariant: `Operator(QFT(n))` equals `F_{jk}=exp(2πi jk/2^n)/sqrt(2^n)` (up to the bit-reversal convention declared by `do_swaps`)
checkers.rationale: the transform's defining identity.

checkers.alarm: commuting case error `> C*eps_d*d^2*||H|| t`; or error for `2r` exceeds error for `r` by more than `tol`
checkers.invariant: `|| U_PF(t,r) - exp(-iHt) ||` is non-increasing in `r` (up to a floor) and `O((t/r)^order)`; for commuting terms it is exact
checkers.rationale: dynamics simulation is the main use.

checkers.alarm: the phase-aligned amplitude difference exceeds `tol = 1e-7*(1+size(out)/100) + 8*sqrt(1e-9)*n_blocks`, `n_blocks` the number of multi-qubit instructions of the input (each resynthesised block is a Weyl decomposition specialised within the library's default infidelity)
checkers.invariant: the output prepares, from `|0...0>`, the same state as the input up to a global phase, after undoing the layout permutation; when the call states `qubits_initially_zero=False`, the full unitary is preserved up to global phase
checkers.precondition: circuit of `<= 6` qubits, unitary gates, any optimization level, any coupling map, no ancilla added (`out.num_qubits = in.num_qubits`), `approximation_degree = 1.0`
checkers.rationale: the semantic-preservation law of the whole compiler stack.
